scopeBasis: The card's five items. In scope: src/control/runs.mjs, src/control/termination.mjs, src/control/reaper.mjs, src/jobs/reap.mjs, src/cli.mjs, the named jobs (bastrop-publish, verify-walk, staging-reset, restamp-access, f10-cad-loop, conformant when keyed by --run-id), tests and fakes. Deliberately excluded and named: a termination_records recorder column (a migration the rebuilt image would depend on while the loop runs; the card allows a run_event and that is what carries recorder/reason/execution/matched_by); jobs the card does not name (snapshot, cc-publish, bexar-cad, bexar-edges, landing-import, manifest-import, access-policy-prestep, lease-v2-migrate, hold-refuse-run) get the identity stamp through startRun's default env on Cloud Run but keep their direct writeTermination closes (a duplicate there now refuses ALREADY_TERMINATED instead of raising 23505: same class, not a regression, not fixed, listed in leave_behind); close evidence for reconcile-termination is implemented for phase publish only (publish_runs + walk), every other phase refuses RECONCILE_NO_EVIDENCE naming that; a --skip-walk publish refuses (walk it first).

findingsForPlanner: Reap ticks are executions of factory-conformant (the scheduler posts factory-conformant:run with args reap). Under the old fallback an unnamed stage-e-conformant child row started within 90 s of a tick could have been attached to the finished reap execution (job affinity factory-conformant). Not observed; gone with name-only matching; named so a quiet reaper is not read as proof the heuristic was safe.

Rows the old image writes between merge and deploy carry no name; with SINCE = merge time they are never time-matched and, if they hang, orphan by their age bound (A-022(5)). That is the safe direction.

Cloud Run sets CLOUD_RUN_JOB and CLOUD_RUN_EXECUTION on every job execution, so jobs whose templates lack FACTORY_CLOUD (factory-snapshot, cloudbuild.yaml:43) still record host cloud-run-job and their name through startRun's default env; no template change is needed for item 1.

termination_records has no recorder column; recorder / reason / execution / matched_by live in the run_events row kind termination written with every termination from this change on. Records written before it report recorder null (an absence). A migration adding recorded_by / reason columns is a clean follow-up once the image sequencing allows it (leave_behind).

The run-status vocabulary finding from cards B and C stands and the reconcile verb follows it: a normally closed, walked publish ends with runs.status = 'success' (writeTermination writes status = exit_kind after the job's own 'succeeded'), so the correction sets 'success', not 'succeeded'.

src/jobs/staging-reset.mjs read its NEON_* variables from process.env while taking an env parameter; it now reads them from env (the parameter) and takes deps.connectFn / deps.createBranchFn, which is what made it testable.
reaper.mjs terminate() wrote runs.status a second time after writeTermination (card A leftover); removed. writeTermination is the one writer of that field per termination.
